none: PAS LON-E16AD4: A Roman pottery stamped base sherd from a Samian bowl.
contea di ritrovamento: Greater London (Inghilterra e Galles)

A Roman pottery stamped base sherd from a Samian bowl (AD50-110). The sherd has the characteristic fine red fabric with a high gloss slipped exterior. It is most likely South Gaulish. The stamp probably reads “MODI”. Dimensions: weight: 40.42g. Identification by Fiona Seeley, Roman specialist MoLAS
